title: Is Sorted Ascending
prompt: A data import step needs to confirm values are already sorted. Write a function that returns true when the numbers are in non-decreasing order.

explanation.beginner:
Example: isSortedAscending([1,2,2,4]) produces true. State the comparison rule and tie behavior explicitly, and copy input before any in-place sort when the contract preserves it.

Compare “rejects unsorted arrays”: input [[1,3,2]] produces false. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
State the comparison rule and tie behavior explicitly, and copy input before any in-place sort when the contract preserves it.

Tempting mistake: A boolean comparator is not a valid three-way numeric comparator. Equal keys also need a predictable tie policy.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “rejects unsorted arrays”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
